# SPEC: src/relay/loop-fixes.test.ts
# MAX-EFFORT MISSION DRAFT (SECOND JULIUS), CANDIDATE H: four latent defects in the Loop Engine's gates (completion verdict, no-blocking-criteria completion, scheduled-spend pause
# threshold, the shared instant reader), found by READING production Relay code. Real tracked source, byte-identical to the repository's. A DRAFT for review: not registered (no
# MISSION_LIMITS, no role-effort line, no gate), and it declares `limits.coderRuntimeMinutes`, so it needs the coder-runtime-budget layer (crt r2) to parse and its own clearance.
#
# The coder cannot run commands, so what it writes is judged by the independent reviewer against the acceptance criteria as well as by the seeded specification, which pins the MAIN
# behaviours of each fix and deliberately not every wider invariant: those are the criteria's job. Nothing here forces, injects or counts a reviewer finding.
#
# THE SLICE: the completion gate (`loop-completion.ts`), the scheduled-spend gate (`cron-budget.ts`), the scheduler whose exported `readIsoInstantWithOffset` is the one instant rule the
# cron modules import (`loop-scheduler.ts`), and one of those consumers, read-only (`cron-approvals.ts`). Run-time import closure of the spec: these 4 files; every other import in them
# is type-only (`../trace/trace-types`, `../contracts`, `../../modes`) and vanishes under type stripping.
# EDITABLE: loop-completion.ts, cron-budget.ts, loop-scheduler.ts. READ-ONLY: cron-approvals.ts.
# DELIBERATELY UNPINNED by the seeded specification (the criteria and the reviewer judge them): whether a required review that has NOT RUN, or an approval by a reviewer that was NOT
# independent, counts as missing corroboration (claimed_complete) or as a failed requirement (incomplete); which top segment of the approved/reviewed/claimed_complete mission-verdict
# ladder counts as a trust shortfall (claim-only evidence with those verdicts is unpinned); for D, whether the verdict is claimed_complete or incomplete, and whether a Loop with no
# blocking criteria and ATTESTED evidence still verifies; that a design choice is stated in a comment; the exact refusal reason of a fraction finer than one part per million (pause, or
# invalid_budget_configuration) and whether 0.0000006 is refused or accepted at a zero spend; every spelling of T24:00 (refused or next-day midnight); that the reasons and checks lists
# are otherwise unchanged; collateral change; input mutation; exported names and signatures; what cron-approvals does (it is read-only for the coder).
